description: What a printed issue of a Substack costs: pages estimated from the chosen posts' word and image counts (or the given page count), then the itemised price (Mixam printing, shipping, tax, Stripe, our margin) at 1, 5, 10 and 25 copies or the number asked. Example questions: how much to print my Substack; cost of 20 copies of my newsletter as a magazine; price of a 40-page zine.

essays.description: How many recent essays when no slugs are given (default 8)

pages.description: A page count, instead of a Substack

post_slugs.description: The essays, by slug; without them the most recent print-suited posts are used

substack.description: The Substack: a URL, a subdomain or a custom domain
